versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation for review endpoint parameters, including required platform values and disabled platforms.
- Added detailed platform/endpoint support matrix clarifying which OTAs support reviews and listings.
- Expanded sections on async processing, partial failures, and API polling best practices.
- Listed known limitations for pagination, platform gaps, and externally-sourced IDs.
- Updated skill category tag from "travel" to "integrations" in metadata.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

Initial release of the airbnb-reviews skill.

- Fetch normalized Airbnb reviews for a listing, preserving original rating scales.
- Requires a StayingAPI key (free test keys available).
- Supports direct API or OAuth-based access.
- Provides paginated review data with cross-platform schema compatibility.
- No extra dependencies needed; simply set up the environment variable and go.
- Useful for quickly retrieving ratings and guest feedback for an Airbnb listing.
